traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Dipteridaceae: terrestrial ferns on creeping, bristly or hairy stems; each frond of two fan-shaped halves with a fine net of veins; sori without indusium scattered over the underside (Dipteris). Two fans cut from the stalk's top read here as a palmately parted blade.
